about: The life of a plugin as the user sees it (rich-plugins 4.14, O-124), written by hand and never captured. The plugin is parity/plugins/life (TS) and its Rust twin in crates/tui/tests/all/plugin_machines.rs. An observation is line/palette/row/dialog: the plugin's line in home.footer (A, B or -), whether the palette finds its commands (yes or no), its row in the plugin manager (on, off or failed), and which of its dialogs shows (prompt, confirm, alert or -). While a dialog shows, the readers open neither the palette nor the manager, which would replace it, so the first three are ?. Actions: toggle is enter on its row in the plugin manager; flip, throw, arm, dialog, confirm and alert run its palette commands Life flip, Life throw, Life arm (the next setup throws), Life dialog (opens its prompt), Life confirm (asks whether to flip the line) and Life alert (flips the line once it closes); enter answers the confirm yes; escape closes a dialog, which answers the confirm no; reload puts a new build of the plugin in place. TS is the specification: an enable whose setup throws shows the error in a toast and leaves the row as it was, and a plugin's dialog stays open when it reloads; answered after the reload, it reaches nothing the user sees. A row in xfail is a known difference, [client, deviation file or finding:<name>, 'state action observation'].
